titulo_en: The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants

textos.O meio-termo é o maior grupo da recepção: The middle ground is the largest group in the reception (~40% of ratings). Opinions examine the same aspects of the production and diverge on the outcome: most of those who recommend it approve of the parallel with earlier chapters of the franchise, while most of those who do not recommend it find the writing weak and repetitive compared with the original film.
textos.Humor apelativo e repetitivo (piadas de: Cheap, repetitive humor (butt and scatological jokes)
textos.Várias reviews criticam o excesso de pia: Several reviews criticize the excess of jokes involving butts and scatological humor, finding them repetitive and unfunny.
textos.O estilo de animação em 3D foi bastante: The 3D animation style was widely criticized for looking artificial, without the texture and charm of the original drawn animation.
textos.Muitas reviews apontam que a trama é fra: Many reviews point out that the plot is weak, drawn out and recycles elements from earlier films, without originality.
textos.Diversas opiniões destacam que o filme é: Several opinions stress that the film is boring and has no truly funny moments, making the experience tedious.

textos.A inclusão da rapper Ice Spice e outras: The inclusion of rapper Ice Spice and other cameos was seen as out of place and unnecessary for a children's film.
textos.As reviews frequentemente afirmam que es: Reviews frequently state that this film does not come close to the 2004 original, whether in quality, humor or soul.
textos.Nostalgia e comparação com filmes anteri: Nostalgia and comparison with earlier films
textos.Vários espectadores sentem falta da anim: Several viewers miss the original 2D animation and consider the franchise's first films superior, although they still feel affection for the series and its characters.
textos.As piadas são vistas como apelativas par: The jokes are seen as pandering to children, with many crude jokes and moments that sound forced, although some still get laughs.
textos.Roteiro previsível e reutilização de ele: Predictable script and reuse of elements
textos.A narrativa é considerada fraca e recicl: The narrative is considered weak and recycles ideas from earlier films, without bringing much originality or surprise.
textos.A animação em 3D divide opiniões: alguns: The 3D animation divides opinion: some praise the attempt to recreate the original style, while others prefer the classic 2D and criticize the look.

textos.A atuação de Mark Hamill como o Holandês: Mark Hamill's performance as the Flying Dutchman is well received, bringing charisma and fun to the role.
textos.Ritmo acelerado e excesso de estímulos: Fast pace and excess of stimuli
textos.O filme é criticado por ser muito aceler: The film is criticized for being too fast and full of constant stimuli, which is tiring and hurts the experience.
textos.As reviews destacam que o filme é engraç: Reviews stress that the film is funny, with jokes that recall the series' classic humor, including slapstick moments and visual gags that got laughs.
textos.Muitas reviews comparam este filme aos a: Many reviews compare this film with the franchise's earlier ones, considering it better than the latest releases but still inferior to the first film, which is regarded as unmatched.
textos.A animação é elogiada por sua qualidade: The animation is praised for its quality and colorful style, with some reservations about the use of CGI and lighting problems, but overall it is seen as beautiful and effective.
textos.Várias reviews expressam apego nostálgic: Several reviews express nostalgic attachment to the series and the older films, and longtime fans share that the film brought back fond memories and moving moments.
textos.A dublagem é elogiada, especialmente a a: The voice acting is praised, especially Mark Hamill's performance as the Flying Dutchman, which is seen as a good addition, although some prefer the original voice actor.
textos.O roteiro é considerado simples e previs: The script is considered simple and predictable by some, with pacing that can drag at the start or lose steam at the end, but it is still fun and suitable for children.

textos.Dirigido por Derek Drymon, Bob Esponja:: Directed by Derek Drymon, The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants (2025) is an adventure, comedy and fantasy animation. In the plot, the protagonist and his friends take on a chaotic journey through the underworld after summoning the ghost pirate Flying Dutchman, discovering the value of courage and unity in the face of the unknown.
textos.A experiência é estruturada sobre uma es: The experience is built on a three-dimensional animation aesthetic, developed at a fast pace and full of comic stimuli.
textos.Os grupos debatem essencialmente os mesm: The groups debate essentially the same elements and agree on what the film presents, diverging only in their verdict on how well those choices work. In a good portion of the ratings (~40%), about half address nostalgia and the comparison with the series' earlier features. In addition, many point to the childish humor built on repetitive jokes, while a significant share highlight the script's predictability and the reuse of formulas already familiar from the franchise.
textos.Numa parte menor das notas (~36%), para: In a smaller share of the ratings (~36%), for them, several criticize the cheap tone of the repetitive scatological jokes. In this segment, a good portion reject the 3D animation as artificial and charmless, while a considerable number emphasize the weakness and lack of originality of the writing.
textos.Por fim, numa parcela das notas (~25%),: Finally, in a share of the ratings (~25%), the perception is favorable: in this reading, about half praise the effectiveness of the humor and comedy on display. Many also draw on comparison with past productions to value the current result, and a significant share praise the quality of the visuals and animation.
